editorial:
Imagine stepping back into 1972, where the fashion is funky and the woods are way creepier than they look. You get thrown into the deep end with a group of curious explorers who find a book they really should have left alone. The vibe is a perfect mix of old-school grit and modern scares, making you feel like you are right there in that dusty cabin. It is a wild ride that shows you exactly how the evil started long before the original movie took place, and the characters feel like real people you would actually hang out with.

The acting is top-notch, and the gore is just over-the-top enough to make you laugh and scream at the same time. While the middle part drags a little bit, the final act hits hard with some crazy twists you will not see coming. You should definitely stream this in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to see all the blood splatter in high detail, or just rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night. If you are a big fan of the series, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a no-brainer.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, you see that the main character cannot actually stop the demon. He tries to burn the book, but the evil spirit jumps into his best friend instead. The twist is that the book was a trap all along to find a new host. It ends with the possessed friend smiling at the camera as the screen goes black, proving that the curse is now permanent and ready to spread.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves scary movies with a lot of blood and a retro feel.
